n: Kennesaw State strikes first with a rushing touchdown and extra point, taking a 7-0 lead in the first quarter. Both streamers discuss player recruitment, roster depth, and the crowd size at Kentucky's stadium. Kennesaw State starts strong on offense while Kentucky's defense struggles to stop the run.

Kennesaw State and Kentucky trade blows in an exciting second quarter. Kennesaw State uses the run game and some clutch throws to stay competitive against Kentucky's passing attack. Both teams manage touchdowns and field goals as the half winds down.

A thrilling and chaotic third quarter sees several turnovers, including a pick-six by Kennesaw State's Wright to briefly grab momentum. Both defenses come up with big stops, but Kentucky manages to respond with a crucial fourth-quarter touchdown to reclaim the lead.

Kennesaw State rallied in the fourth quarter with crucial big plays and touchdowns by quarterback J. Williams. Kentucky struggled to contain Kennesaw's offense late in the game, ultimately failing to convert on fourth down near the end. Kennesaw State secured a 35-27 victory to close out the fourth quarter.

This segment covers the final seconds and post-game screens of Kennesaw State's 35-27 victory over Kentucky. The streamers review the post-game XP report and discuss how the game unfolded, with Clay venting about a costly interception and overall performance while navigating through menu screens.

r.h: Kennesaw State Outduels Kentucky 35-27 in Week 11 Thriller
p: Coach Clay and Kennesaw State headed on the road in Week 11 and secured a hard-fought 35-27 victory against Coach Winders and Kentucky. Kennesaw State struck first with an early rushing touchdown, setting the tone against a Kentucky defense that struggled to contain the run. Both teams traded blows in a high-octane first half featuring clutch throws from Jonas Williams, a 1-yard touchdown pass from Nick Tobin to C. Neptune, and a booming 49-yard field goal by Kellen Lyles as the score tightened.

The contest turned chaotic in the second half with crucial turnovers, including an interception thrown by Williams to Rutherford and a pick-six by Kennesaw State's Wright to shift the momentum. Kentucky fought back to reclaim the lead in the fourth quarter, but Kennesaw State rallied with explosive plays. J. Williams delivered the decisive blows with a 30-yard touchdown pass to K. Riley followed by a stunning 40-yard rushing touchdown. Kentucky's late comeback attempt ended when they threw a game-sealing interception, allowing Kennesaw State to run out the clock and seal the 35-27 win.
r.o: Coach Clay's Kennesaw State squad rallied late in the fourth quarter to outlast Kentucky 35-27 in a Week 11 thriller.
r.pp: J. Williams exploded for a 40-yard rushing touchdown in the fourth quarter, extending the lead and sealing the victory for Kennesaw State.
